citations.note: Wright-Patterson AFB sits at the Mad River terminus, adjacent to the watershed point. The base is the strongest documented federal-enclave signal in the network after Lima.

The installation itself, from the DoD MIRTA site register (`watermark --site wpafb enclave`). Planning-grade and a partial footprint (5,230 mapped acres against the ~8,200 the 1991 CERCLA agreement states), so it places the base without bounding it.
